title: Review eval case
description: One past change where the team knows what was wrong. Ten of these make a project's eval set (evals/review/cases/<project>/<id>.json).

id.description: Unique within the project; also the file name without .json.

pr.description: A merged pull request. The runner resolves base = first parent of its merge commit, head = its merge commit.

base.description: Commit to diff from, when there is no pull request or its merge commit is unsuitable (rebase merges).

head.description: Commit to diff to. The review sees the code as it was here.

summary.description: What was wrong, specifically enough that a judge can tell whether a finding is the same problem.

files.description: Where the problem lives, relative to the repo root.

severity.description: How REVIEW.md would grade it. Defaults to Important.

source.description: Why we know: a bug that reached users, or a Review Logs row with a Human Only finding.

reference.description: Where the evidence is: a Jira key, an incident link, or the Review Logs PR cell.

added.description: YYYY-MM-DD the case joined the set.
